Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 15
, Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer applied only the “2+ bedrooms” filter and did not apply the “2+ bathrooms” filter or restrict by the required sold-date range on Zillow. This incomplete filtering meant the subsequent selection (“67 Maclellan Rd”) was not verified to have at least 2 baths or to fall within the date window, nor confirmed as the smallest qualifying home by square footage, directly leading to the wrong final answer.
